statement: Let f1, . . . , fn be a homogeneous regular sequence in C[x1, . . . , xn], of degrees 2 ≤ a1 ≤ · · · ≤ an. There are a field extension k/C, a central division k-algebra ∆, and a commutative graded k-subalgebra k[x1, . . . , xn] ⊆ A ⊆ N = ∆[x1, . . . , xn] generated by finitely many elements of degree one, containing t1, . . . , tn ∈ A1, such that tah h = chfh + X ℓ<h Bhℓfℓ + X ℓ>h Chℓtℓ (1 ≤ h ≤ n). (2.1) Here ch ∈ k×, Bhℓ, Chℓ ∈ A, and every summand has degree ah. Moreover, {tα = tα1 1 · · · tαn n : α ∈ Zn ≥0} is a graded left-∆ basis of the full algebra N.
